summary: Iteration 27 — Full backend + frontend regression of the new cover-first verify flow, admin Indonesian shell, admin Legality signatory/signature CRUD + single-active enforcement, and admin demo/sample PDF previews. ALL 10 pytest tests PASS (backend/tests/test_iter27_cover_and_legality.py). ALL 14 Playwright UI checks PASS across two runs. Findings: (1) Public /verify and / default to ENGLISH (verify labels 'Verify AGR Certificate Authenticity', 'Certificate Registration Number', 'Verify Certificate'; homepage shows 'MORE INFORMATION' buttons and 'CONTACT US' section). (2) /verify with seeded 'AGR-TST-000001-26' renders verify-result → verify-cover-image (PNG blob from GET /api/verify/cover/AGR-TST-000001-26 200 image/png) + verify-result-number 'AGR-TST-000001-26' + verify-view-details button; NO inner detail block. (3) verify-view-details opens verify-pdf-modal with verify-pdf-iframe (blob: URL from GET /api/verify/pdf/AGR-TST-000001-26 200 application/pdf, ≥2 pages, no 'qrcode' substring in PDF bytes). verify-pdf-close removes the modal. (4) Well-formed non-existent 'AGR-ZMD-000099-26' → GET /api/verify/cover/... returns 404; UI shows verify-search-error 'Certificate not found.' and NO verify-result. (5) Bad format 'abc' fails client regex → verify-search-error 'Certificate not found.' (no network call). (6) Homepage has both home-whatsapp-process and home-whatsapp-contact, each labelled 'MORE INFORMATION' with href='https://wa.me/6287812128884'. (7) Admin login (admin@azuris.local) lands on /admin/legalitas; sidebar is Indonesian: DASBOR / LEGALITAS / SERTIFIKAT / BATU MULIA / PERHIASAN / GARANSI / VISUAL & KONTEN / PENGATURAN — confirming forceLocale='id' wraps the admin shell independently from the public English default. (8) Legality admin page: created TEST_UI_Iter27_A with signatory_name/position + active checked; POST /api/admin/legality → 201 with signatory fields preserved and active_for_certificates=true. Signature upload input accepts a PNG → legality-signature-preview renders (blob:), and legality-signature-remove detaches it (backend DELETE /api/admin/legality/{uuid}/signature → 200, subsequent GET → 404). (9) Creating a SECOND active record (TEST_UI_Iter27_B) makes it the only one bearing the [data-testid^=legality-active-badge-] badge; the first record loses active status (single-active enforcement verified both via GET list and via UI badge count=1). (10) Admin demo PDFs (Bearer): GET /api/admin/certificates/demo-preview → 200 application/pdf ≥2 pages; GET /api/admin/certificates/sample-card → 200 application/pdf. Both are pure streams and did NOT create any DB records (counter last_number and business collection counts untouched — verified by main agent's earlier baseline plus the fact that no /api/admin/certificates POST issue was invoked). Test data cleanup: all TEST_ legality records deleted post-test (list now []).
critical_code_review_comments: verify.py: `_rate_limit` uses process-local in-memory deque per IP — sufficient for MVP but does not survive multi-worker/deploy scaling; document this in ops notes if not already.
VerifyPage.tsx openPdf: no error surface if GET /api/verify/pdf/{n} fails after a successful cover fetch (returns silently). Consider showing a small inline message. Minor.

LegalityAdminPage.tsx renders duplicate `data-testid=legality-signature-upload` inputs (one in the 'has preview / replace' branch, one in the 'no preview / upload' branch). Both are useful UX-wise, but tests must select carefully. Consider suffixing testids (-replace/-new) for unambiguous automation.
seed_data_creation: Created two temporary legality records via API + UI (TEST_UI_Iter27_A, TEST_UI_Iter27_B, plus TEST_Iter27_Leg_A / TEST_Iter27_Leg_B from pytest). ALL DELETED at end of run — GET /api/admin/legality now returns items=[]. No certificate issuance, no gemstone create, counter last_number untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seeded certificate 'AGR-TST-000001-26' is still present (main-agent will purge). Public default = English; admin default = Indonesian (LanguageProvider forceLocale='id' wraps /login and /admin/*). The 2-page verify PDF has no QR/barcode. Signature upload uses immutable-copy semantics (new LegalityDocument uuid each time); backend detaches only on DELETE. Single-active-for-certificates is enforced via _ensure_single_active on both POST and PUT of /api/admin/legality.
